body:
> True pseudo-random number generation (PRNG) is incredibly difficult to get right. 

This sounds a bit strange to me, psuedo-random means that it's not truly random so "true pseudo-random" is very confusing. 

I think it would be better to replace with something like
> Cryptographically secure pseudo-random number generation (CSPRNG) is incredibly difficult to get right.

comments.body:
True PRNG is difficult to get right, i did edit the statement to say that a cryptographically secure PRNG should be used.
